title: 短语动词
explanation:
## 短语动词:动词 + 介词/副词

短语动词由动词加一个小品词(介词或副词)构成,整体意思往往不能从字面猜出。它是六级完形与翻译的高频考点。

## 常见类型

1. **动词 + 介词**(后必接宾语):look after(照顾), depend on(依靠), deal with(处理)。
2. **动词 + 副词**(可分可合):turn on/off, put on, give up。宾语是代词时**必须放中间**:turn it on, give it up,不能说 turn on it。
3. **动词 + 副词 + 介词**:look forward to(期待), come up with(想出), put up with(忍受)。注意 look forward to 后接 doing。
4. **动词 + 介词 + 名词**:take care of(照顾), pay attention to(注意)。

## 一词多义

get 类短语:get up(起床), get over(克服), get along with(相处), get rid of(摆脱), get through(通过)。take 类:take off(起飞/脱下), take up(占据/从事), take over(接管), take after(像)。

## 学习策略

1. 按动词归类记忆,一组一组背。
2. 关注及物性:介词短语后必接宾语,副词短语宾语可前可后。
3. 完形中注意动词与介词搭配的固定性:prevent...from, spend...on, accuse...of。

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.note: turn off 是"动词+副词",宾语 the lights 可放中间。

examples.en: This problem is hard to deal with.
examples.note: deal with 是"动词+介词",必须连在一起后接宾语。

examples.en: I am looking forward to meeting you soon.
examples.note: look forward to 中的 to 是介词,后接 doing。

examples.en: It took him years to get over the failure.
examples.cn: 他花了好几年才从失败中走出来。
examples.note: get over 表示"克服,从……恢复"。

errors.note: 代词宾语必须放在"动词+副词"中间。

errors.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
errors.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
errors.note: to 是介词,后接动名词 hearing。

errors.wrong: She takes after of her mother.
errors.note: take after(像)是"动词+介词"结构,不加 of。

quiz.q: Can you ___ this new word in the dictionary?
We have to ___ the bad weather.
quiz.note: put up with 表示"忍受"。

quiz.q: He ___ the meeting because he was ill.
